title: Strictly bounded, manually triggered, Solana-only, GMGN-only 1433-wallet statistical profile full live run
objective: Based on hash-verified Chain.fm Solana address-cleaning output, execute one manually triggered, strictly bounded, read-only GMGN official-API full 1433-wallet statistical profile run. Deterministically validate Base58/32-byte addresses and select all 1,433 unique valid wallets in sequence. Fetch 7d and 30d statistics serially with >=1,000ms between adjacent requests and a hard 2,866-request budget. Save only allowlisted normalized metrics to designated external derived directory; all GMGN values remain source=gmgn and verificationStatus=unverified. GMGN_PRIVATE_KEY is neither read nor passed to the statistics subprocess. The run is not independently completed until the downstream audit SOL-GMGN-WALLET-PROFILE-FULL-1433-LIVE-AUDIT-001 is GREEN.
forbidden_actions: Do not call BSC, Robinhood, multichain, or any chain other than Solana.
Do not use web scraping, browser automation, Cloudflare bypass, GMGN Web pages, or non-official endpoints.
Do not execute trades, signatures, transfers, or orders.
Do not execute cron, background loops, auto-discovery, or automatic daily updates.
Do not call Helius or perform on-chain verification in this task.
Do not write to databases, Redis, queues, or production systems.
Do not print, persist, or commit API keys, private keys, raw payloads, raw errors, or full user address lists in Git.
Do not claim GMGN metrics are chain-confirmed facts, and do not use LLMs to score or explain individual wallets.
Do not read, display, persist, or pass GMGN_PRIVATE_KEY to the statistics subprocess; only GMGN_API_KEY may be supplied to the official GMGN statistics client.
Do not persist plaintext addresses, labels, credential URLs, raw provider payloads, complete provider exceptions, or non-allowlisted normalized fields in the external output or Git artifacts.
